cohort: A single 26-year-old pregnant woman presented with pituitary apoplexy at 35 weeks of gestation.
finding: This case report details the first instance of isolated persistent hypogonadotropic hypogonadism following pituitary apoplexy in a pregnant patient.
mod_finding: The patient underwent cesarean delivery at 36 weeks of gestation and subsequently retrieved normal pituitary function, except for persistent amenorrhea.
